_about: Batch B8 (multi-GPU step, DP votes, CP, hardware discovery, parallel_state, shm_broadcast, shared_memory, deep_cluster). Owner: B8 writer.

step-vote.short: An all-reduce over the data-parallel group. With it, all DP replicas agree to run a prefill step or a decode step, so that their collectives match.

engine-rank.short: The index of one engine process (one DP replica). The global rank of a device process is engine_rank × cp_size + cp_rank.

cp-follower.short: A context-parallel rank other than the driver (cp_rank 1 or more). It runs in its own process, gets every method call and every input from the driver, and does not sample.

bucket-buffer.short: A DeepEP communication buffer. DeepInfer's CPManager uses one per CP group for the all-gather of keys, values and hidden states in a prefill step.

posix-shm.short: Operating-system memory that several processes on one host can map at the same time, by name (on Linux, files in /dev/shm). Not the same as GPU shared memory (SMEM).

shm-message-queue.short: DeepInfer's one-writer, many-reader queue in shared memory (shm_broadcast.py). The CP driver uses it to send method calls and small objects to the CP followers.

zeromq.short: A message library for sockets (Python package zmq). MessageQueue uses its publish-subscribe sockets for start-up handshakes and for objects that are too large for a shared-memory chunk.

numa-node.short: A group of CPU cores with the memory that is nearest to them. Memory on another node is slower. A GPU or NPU is also attached near one node.

cpu-affinity.short: The set of CPU cores on which the operating system may run a process. DeepInfer sets it so that each rank runs on cores near its device.

procfs.short: A virtual file system in Linux that shows kernel and driver data as files. The NVIDIA driver lists one folder per GPU in /proc/driver/nvidia/gpus.

sysfs.short: A virtual file system in Linux that shows devices as folders and files, for example the NUMA node of a PCI device in /sys/bus/pci/devices/<bus id>/numa_node.

nvml.short: NVIDIA Management Library (libnvidia-ml). It reads GPU data, such as the compute capability, without a CUDA context.

compute-capability.short: The NVIDIA version number of a GPU architecture, as (major, minor). SM100 GPUs have major 10.
